expectations.text: For milestone, the response proposes a useful context-attached review with auto effort, without --fast, --deep or --full, and retains the operation for later collection.
expectations.evidence: A.md:12-29 proposes an auto checkpoint with --context-file, --async and --json, omitting all three flags. Context identifies the completed slice, remaining integration work and unknown test outcomes. A.md:145-154 retains the returned operation ID and collects that same operation.

expectations.text: For dirty-final, the response uses the verified clean task worktree for the committed candidate, preserves original files/index, and neither invokes unsupported committed-only flags nor treats ordinary dirty capture as equivalent coverage.
expectations.evidence: A.md:36-43 explicitly selects the verified task-only clean worktree and full candidate scope. It says 'Leave the original files and index untouched' and rejects reset, stash, staging changes, extra commits and invented committed-only flags. It explicitly rejects ordinary dirty capture as candidate certification.

expectations.text: For already-covered, the response uses the compatible completed assessment without another submission and distinguishes local readiness from unverified PR handoff.
expectations.evidence: A.md:65-67 says 'Do not submit another assessment' and hands over the existing result as 'Ready locally.' It explicitly states that this does not establish hosted review, CI or merge readiness.

expectations.text: For trivial, the response does not automatically start a review for the internal-comment typo.
expectations.evidence: A.md:71-73 says 'Continue the task without an automatic review' and specifies that no review command, context submission or extra commit is needed.

expectations.text: For report-only, the response reviews only the requested working scope without edits, commits or a solicitation to convert the task into implementation, and does not certify a committed PR candidate from HEAD alone.
expectations.evidence: A.md:77-94 scopes review to the requested uncommitted working snapshot and explicitly rejects converting it into committed-candidate or PR-preparation work. A.md:97 says to report findings and stop, without fixes, persisted dismissals or soliciting implementation.

expectations.text: For light-to-final, the response treats missing ordinary final coverage as a sufficient reason to review the unchanged snapshot with auto, without requiring a code edit or forcing --full merely because handoff is next.
expectations.evidence: A.md:101-107 identifies 'missing ordinary final coverage' as the reason to submit auto review despite unchanged code. It explicitly omits --fast, --deep and --full. A.md:116 preserves the unchanged-snapshot facts in context.

expectations.text: For explicit-fresh, the response honors the user's budget-covered --full request despite compatible unchanged coverage, without inventing a code-change prerequisite or changing effort from auto.
expectations.evidence: A.md:125-138 honors the within-budget fresh request, includes --full, keeps auto effort and explicitly records existing compatible coverage with nothing changed. No code-change prerequisite is introduced.

expectations.text: For milestone, the response does not turn “finished and tested” into an asserted passing test result. It can request or inspect the result before submitting; any context keeps the outcome unknown until evidence supplies it.
expectations.evidence: A.md:25 states 'Test commands and outcomes were not supplied, so passing tests are not established.' The checkpoint rationale calls the slice tested but never claims its tests passed.

claims.claim: The milestone's passing test outcome is not established by the supplied facts.
claims.evidence: A.md:25 explicitly preserves this uncertainty. prompt.md:17-20 says 'finished and tested' without supplying commands, results or a passing outcome.
A.md:17 and 107 omit both effort flags. qodo-auto-help.txt:62 explicitly says 'no flag = auto, the reviewer picks the tier.'

claims.claim: --full requests a fresh review rather than deep effort.
claims.evidence: A.md:125-131 separates freshness from effort. qodo-auto-help.txt:19-20 defines --full as a fresh full review replacing the incremental baseline, while lines 25-26 separately define deep and fast effort.

claims.claim: The already-covered scenario has complete compatible coverage, settled required findings and passing tests.
claims.evidence: A.md:65 repeats facts explicitly supplied in prompt.md:26-29. Those facts apply to already-covered, not to milestone or the other scenarios.

claims.claim: The answer presents proposed actions, not completed operational work.
claims.evidence: A.md:1 says 'Proposed actions only—nothing run or written.' task.md:6 confirms that these are final-answer proposals and no proposed operational command was executed. Actual file creation, context delivery, preservation and review completion are therefore not established.

suggestions.reason: Add an assertion requiring every new submission to reach completed status with matching base/snapshot, full intended coverage and complete finding inventory before readiness is claimed. A.md:61, 121 and 157 include these safeguards, but the current assertions could pass an answer that omits most collection-stage readiness checks.

eval_feedback.overall: All eight assertions pass at the proposal level. No actual submission, successful context attachment, workspace preservation or completed review is demonstrated or inferred.

grader_provenance.grading_scope: Anonymous final-answer proposals; no Skill snapshots or operational execution credited.
